[31m+[39m
[31m+   /**[39m
[31m+    * Maps an API endpoint + HTTP method to the React Query keys that should be[39m
[31m+    * invalidated after a successful mutation. This ensures consistent cache[39m
[31m+    * invalidation across all mutation paths.[39m
[31m+    *[39m
[31m+    * Usage: after a mutation succeeds, call[39m
[31m+    *   `queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey })` for each key returned.[39m
[31m+    *[39m
[31m+    * Rules:[39m
[31m+    * - Application submit → invalidate ['student-dashboard-polling'], ['applications'][39m
[31m+    * - Admin status change → invalidate ['applications', appId], ['admin-applications'],[39m
[31m+    *   ['admin-dashboard-polling'], ['application-stats'][39m
[31m+    * - Login/logout → queryClient.clear() (handled separately in auth flow)[39m
[31m+    * - Token refresh → does NOT invalidate data caches[39m
[31m+    *[39m
[31m+    * @param endpoint  The API endpoint path (e.g. '/api/v1/applications/123/review/')[39m
[31m+    * @param method    The HTTP method (e.g. 'POST', 'PUT')[39m
[31m+    * @returns Array of React Query key arrays to invalidate[39m
[31m+    *[39m
[31m+    * Requirements: 1.10, 1.11[39m
[31m+    */[39m
[31m+   getQueryInvalidationPatterns([39m
[31m+     endpoint: string,[39m
[31m+     method: string[39m
[31m+   ): string[][] {[39m
[31m+     const upper = method.toUpperCase();[39m
[31m+     const url = new URL(endpoint, 'http://localhost');[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     // Parse REST-style path segments: strip /api/v1/ prefix, split by /[39m
[31m+     // e.g. /api/v1/applications/123/review/ -> ['applications', '123', 'review'][39m
[31m+     const segments = url.pathname[39m
[31m+       .replace(/^\/api(?:\/v1)?\//, '')[39m
[31m+       .split('/')[39m
[31m+       .filter(Boolean);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     const resource = segments[0] ?? '';[39m
[31m+     const id = segments[1] ?? '';[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     // Auth endpoints (login/logout/register/refresh) -> no cache invalidation[39m
[31m+     // Login/logout handled by queryClient.clear() in auth flow[39m
[31m+     // Token refresh must never invalidate data caches[39m
[31m+     if (resource === 'auth') {[39m
[31m+       return [];[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     // Application mutations (student-side)[39m
[31m+     if (resource === 'applications' && ['POST', 'PUT', 'PATCH'].includes(upper)) {[39m
[31m+       const keys: string[][] = [[39m
[31m+         ['applications'],[39m
[31m+         ['student-dashboard-polling'],[39m
[31m+         ['application-stats'],[39m
[31m+       ];[39m
[31m+       if (id) {[39m
[31m+         keys.push(['applications', id]);[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+       return keys;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     // Admin actions[39m
[31m+     if (resource === 'admin' && ['POST', 'PUT', 'PATCH', 'DELETE'].includes(upper)) {[39m
[31m+       const keys: string[][] = [[39m
[31m+         ['admin-applications'],[39m
[31m+         ['admin-dashboard-polling'],[39m
[31m+         ['application-stats'],[39m
[31m+       ];[39m
[31m+       return keys;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     // Document mutations[39m
[31m+     if (resource === 'documents' && ['POST', 'PUT'].includes(upper)) {[39m
[31m+       return [['applications'], ['documents']];[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     // Payment mutations[39m
[31m+     if (resource === 'payments' && ['POST', 'PUT'].includes(upper)) {[39m
[31m+       return [['applications'], ['payment-status']];[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     // Notification mutations[39m
[31m+     if (resource === 'notifications' && ['POST', 'PUT'].includes(upper)) {[39m
[31m+       return [['notification_preferences']];[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     // Default: no automatic React Query invalidation[39m
[31m+     return [];[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   async request<TResponse = unknown>([39m
[31m+     endpoint: string,[39m
[31m+     options: ApiRequestOptions = {}[39m
[31m+   ): Promise<TResponse | null> {[39m
[31m+     const method = (options.method ?? 'GET').toString().toUpperCase();[39m
[31m+     const apiEndpoint = toApiV1Path(endpoint);[39m
[31m+     const service = getServiceName(apiEndpoint);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     const timeoutMs = options.timeout ?? getTimeoutForEndpoint(apiEndpoint);[39m
[31m+     const maxRetries = options.retries ?? MAX_RETRIES;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     // Outer retry loop for network/5xx errors[39m
[31m+     let lastError: unknown;[39m
[31m+     for (let attempt = 0; attempt <= maxRetries; attempt++) {[39m
[31m+       // Wait before retry (skip delay on first attempt)[39m
[31m+       if (attempt > 0) {[39m
[31m+         const delay = RETRY_DELAYS[attempt - 1] ?? RETRY_DELAYS[RETRY_DELAYS.length - 1];[39m
[31m+         await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, delay));[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       try {[39m
[31m+         const result = await this.executeRequest<TResponse>([39m
[31m+           apiEndpoint,[39m
[31m+           method,[39m
[31m+           service,[39m
[31m+           timeoutMs,[39m
[31m+           options[39m
[31m+         );[39m
[31m+         return result;[39m
[31m+       } catch (error) {[39m
[31m+         lastError = error;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+         // Don't retry if the user aborted or it's a 4xx error[39m
[31m+         if (!isRetryableFailure(error)) {[39m
[31m+           throw error;[39m
[31m+         }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+         // Don't retry if we've exhausted attempts[39m
[31m+         if (attempt >= maxRetries) {[39m
[31m+           throw error;[39m
[31m+         }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+         // Log retry attempt (dev only -- terser strips logger.warn in prod)[39m
[31m+         logger.warn([39m
[31m+           `[API Client] Retrying ${method} ${apiEndpoint} (attempt ${attempt + 1}/${maxRetries})`[39m
[31m+         );[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     // Should not reach here, but just in case[39m
[31m+     throw lastError;[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   /**[39m
[31m+    * Execute a single request attempt with timeout support.[39m
[31m+    * Extracted from `request()` to keep the retry loop clean.[39m
[31m+    */[39m
[31m+   private async executeRequest<TResponse>([39m
[31m+     normalizedEndpoint: string,[39m
[31m+     method: string,[39m
[31m+     service: string,[39m
[31m+     timeoutMs: number,[39m
[31m+     options: ApiRequestOptions[39m
[31m+   ): Promise<TResponse | null> {[39m
[31m+     const {[39m
[31m+       headers,[39m
[31m+       timeout: _timeout,[39m
[31m+       retries: _retries,[39m
[31m+       signal: externalSignal,[39m
[31m+       ...restOptions[39m
[31m+     } = options;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     // Create timeout-aware AbortController, linked to any external signal[39m
[31m+     const { controller: timeoutController, clear: clearTimeout_ } =[39m
[31m+       createTimeoutController(timeoutMs, externalSignal as AbortSignal | null);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     const isFormDataRequest =[39m
[31m+       typeof FormData !== 'undefined' && restOptions.body instanceof FormData;[39m
[31m+     const baseHeaders = isFormDataRequest ? {} : this.getBaseHeaders();[39m
[31m+     const requestHeaders = {[39m
[31m+       ...baseHeaders,[39m
[31m+       ...this.normalizeHeaders(headers),[39m
[31m+     };[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     // Attach CSRF token for state-changing requests[39m
[31m+     if (['POST', 'PUT', 'PATCH', 'DELETE'].includes(method)) {[39m
[31m+       const csrfToken = getCsrfToken();[39m
[31m+       if (csrfToken) {[39m
[31m+         requestHeaders['X-CSRF-Token'] = csrfToken;[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     try {[39m
[31m+       const requestInit: RequestInit = {[39m
[31m+         ...restOptions,[39m
[31m+         method,[39m
[31m+         headers: requestHeaders,[39m
[31m+         credentials: 'include', // CRITICAL: Send HTTP-only cookies[39m
[31m+         signal: timeoutController.signal,[39m
[31m+       };[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       // Unified fetch — all methods (GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE) share the[39m
[31m+       // same response pipeline: CSRF capture, error parsing, 401 refresh,[39m
[31m+       // 403 CSRF recovery, envelope unwrapping. (R9.2, R14.4)[39m
[31m+       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}${normalizedEndpoint}`, requestInit);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       // Capture CSRF token from response header (set on login/refresh/session)[39m
[31m+       const responseCsrfToken = response.headers.get('X-CSRF-Token');[39m
[31m+       if (responseCsrfToken) {[39m
[31m+         setCsrfToken(responseCsrfToken);[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       if (!response.ok) {[39m
[31m+         let errorMessage = `API Error: ${response.statusText}`;[39m
[31m+         let errorCode: string | undefined;[39m
[31m+         let fieldErrors: Record<string, string> | undefined;[39m
[31m+         let errorResponseData: Record<string, unknown> | undefined;[39m
[31m+         try {[39m
[31m+           const errorData = await response.text();[39m
[31m+           if (errorData) {[39m
[31m+             const parsed = JSON.parse(errorData);[39m
[31m+             errorMessage = parsed.error || parsed.message || errorMessage;[39m
[31m+             errorCode = parsed.code;[39m
[31m+             errorResponseData = parsed;[39m
[31m+             if (parsed.fieldErrors && typeof parsed.fieldErrors === 'object') {[39m
[31m+               fieldErrors = parsed.fieldErrors as Record<string, string>;[39m
[31m+             } else if (parsed.details && typeof parsed.details === 'object') {[39m
[31m+               // Django REST Framework returns validation errors in `details`[39m
[31m+               // e.g. { details: { program: ["Invalid program reference."] } }[39m
[31m+               const mapped: Record<string, string> = {};[39m
[31m+               for (const [field, messages] of Object.entries(parsed.details)) {[39m
[31m+                 mapped[field] = Array.isArray(messages) ? messages.join(', ') : String(messages);[39m
[31m+               }[39m
[31m+               if (Object.keys(mapped).length > 0) {[39m
[31m+                 fieldErrors = mapped;[39m
[31m+               }[39m
[31m+             }[39m
[31m+           }[39m
[31m+         } catch {[39m
[31m+           // Use default error message[39m
[31m+         }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+         if (fieldErrors && Object.keys(fieldErrors).length > 0) {[39m
[31m+           const formattedFieldErrors = Object.entries(fieldErrors)[39m
[31m+             .map(([field, message]) => {[39m
[31m+               const fieldLabel = field === '_root'[39m
[31m+                 ? 'General'[39m
[31m+                 : field.replace(/\./g, ' ').replace(/_/g, ' ').trim();[39m
[31m+               return `${fieldLabel}: ${message}`;[39m
[31m+             })[39m
[31m+             .join('; ');[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+           errorMessage = formattedFieldErrors || errorMessage;[39m
[31m+         }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+         // 401 intercept-refresh-retry: attempt a single token refresh and retry[39m
[31m+         // Exclude auth endpoints that would cause infinite loops[39m
[31m+         if (response.status === 401 && !isAuthExcludedEndpoint(normalizedEndpoint)) {[39m
[31m+           logger.debug('[API Client] 401 Unauthorized - attempting token refresh');[39m
[31m+           const refreshed = await attemptRefresh();[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+           if (refreshed) {[39m
[31m+             // Replay guard (R9.2): only replay safe methods (GET, HEAD, OPTIONS)[39m
[31m+             // or requests carrying an Idempotency-Key header. Blind replay of[39m
[31m+             // unsafe methods (POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE) without idempotency could[39m
[31m+             // cause duplicate side effects.[39m
[31m+             const isSafeMethod = ['GET', 'HEAD', 'OPTIONS'].includes(method);[39m
[31m+             const hasIdempotencyKey = !!requestHeaders['Idempotency-Key'] || !!requestHeaders['idempotency-key'];[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+             if (!isSafeMethod && !hasIdempotencyKey) {[39m
[31m+               // Cannot safely replay — throw an error indicating refresh succeeded[39m
[31m+               // but the original mutation was not retried[39m
[31m+               const replayError = new Error([39m
[31m+                 'Session refreshed but the request was not retried because it lacks an idempotency key. Please retry the action.'[39m
[31m+               ) as Error & { status: number; code: string; refreshed: boolean };[39m
[31m+               replayError.status = 401;[39m
[31m+               replayError.code = 'REFRESH_NO_REPLAY';[39m
[31m+               replayError.refreshed = true;[39m
[31m+               throw replayError;[39m
[31m+             }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+             // Refresh succeeded — retry the original request once[39m
[31m+             // Re-attach the (possibly rotated) CSRF token[39m
[31m+             if (['POST', 'PUT', 'PATCH', 'DELETE'].includes(method)) {[39m
[31m+               const freshCsrf = getCsrfToken();[39m
[31m+               if (freshCsrf) {[39m
[31m+                 requestHeaders['X-CSRF-Token'] = freshCsrf;[39m
[31m+               }[39m
[31m+             }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+             const retryResponse = await fetch(`${API_BASE}${normalizedEndpoint}`, {[39m
[31m+               ...restOptions,[39m
[31m+               method,[39m
[31m+               headers: requestHeaders,[39m
[31m+               credentials: 'include',[39m
[31m+               signal: timeoutController.signal,[39m
[31m+             });[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+             // Capture CSRF token from retry response[39m
[31m+             const retryCsrf = retryResponse.headers.get('X-CSRF-Token');[39m
[31m+             if (retryCsrf) {[39m
[31m+               setCsrfToken(retryCsrf);[39m
[31m+             }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+             if (retryResponse.ok) {[39m
[31m+               const retryContentType = retryResponse.headers.get('content-type') ?? '';[39m
[31m+               if (retryContentType && !retryContentType.includes('application/json')) {[39m
[31m+                 const rawBody = await retryResponse.text();[39m
[31m+                 return (rawBody || null) as TResponse | null;[39m
[31m+               }[39m
[31m+               const retryPayload = await this.parseJsonSafely<TResponse>(retryResponse, service, normalizedEndpoint);[39m
[31m+               return this.unwrapApiResponse<TResponse>(retryPayload, retryContentType);[39m
[31m+             }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+             // Only treat a second 401 as an auth failure. Other status codes[39m
[31m+             // (e.g. 400 validation errors) should be handled normally — they[39m
[31m+             // are not authentication failures and must not trigger logout.[39m
[31m+             if (retryResponse.status === 401) {[39m
[31m+               const authFailure = getOnAuthFailure();[39m
[31m+               if (authFailure && shouldDispatchAuthFailure()) authFailure();[39m
[31m+               throw new AuthenticationError();[39m
[31m+             }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+             // Non-401 error after successful refresh — parse and throw as a[39m
[31m+             // normal API error so the caller can handle it (e.g. show validation[39m
[31m+             // messages for 400 responses).[39m
[31m+             let retryErrorMessage = `API Error: ${retryResponse.statusText}`;[39m
[31m+             let retryFieldErrors: Record<string, string> | undefined;[39m
[31m+             try {[39m
[31m+               const retryErrorData = await retryResponse.text();[39m
[31m+               if (retryErrorData) {[39m
[31m+                 const parsed = JSON.parse(retryErrorData);[39m
[31m+                 retryErrorMessage = parsed.error || parsed.message || retryErrorMessage;[39m
[31m+                 if (parsed.details && typeof parsed.details === 'object') {[39m
[31m+                   const mapped: Record<string, string> = {};[39m
[31m+                   for (const [field, messages] of Object.entries(parsed.details)) {[39m
[31m+                     mapped[field] = Array.isArray(messages) ? messages.join(', ') : String(messages);[39m
[31m+                   }[39m
[31m+                   if (Object.keys(mapped).length > 0) {[39m
[31m+                     retryFieldErrors = mapped;[39m
[31m+                   }[39m
[31m+                 }[39m
[31m+               }[39m
[31m+             } catch { /* use default */ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+             if (retryFieldErrors && Object.keys(retryFieldErrors).length > 0) {[39m
[31m+               const formatted = Object.entries(retryFieldErrors)[39m
[31m+                 .map(([f, m]) => `${f.replace(/_/g, ' ').trim()}: ${m}`)[39m
[31m+                 .join('; ');[39m
[31m+               retryErrorMessage = formatted || retryErrorMessage;[39m
[31m+             }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+             const retryStatusError = new Error(retryErrorMessage) as Error & { status: number; fieldErrors?: Record<string, string> };[39m
[31m+             retryStatusError.status = retryResponse.status;[39m
[31m+             if (retryFieldErrors) retryStatusError.fieldErrors = retryFieldErrors;[39m
[31m+             const retryEnhanced = ApiErrorHandler.enhanceError({[39m
[31m+               endpoint: normalizedEndpoint,[39m
[31m+               method,[39m
[31m+               statusCode: retryResponse.status,[39m
[31m+               originalError: retryStatusError,[39m
[31m+             });[39m
[31m+             throw retryEnhanced;[39m
[31m+           }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+           // Refresh failed — invoke onAuthFailure and throw[39m
[31m+           const authFailure = getOnAuthFailure();[39m
[31m+           if (authFailure && shouldDispatchAuthFailure()) authFailure();[39m
[31m+           throw new AuthenticationError();[39m
[31m+         }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+         // Handle 401 on excluded auth endpoints (no refresh attempt)[39m
[31m+         if (response.status === 401) {[39m
[31m+           logger.debug('[API Client] 401 on auth endpoint - no refresh attempt');[39m
[31m+         }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+         // 403 CSRF intercept-retry: re-fetch CSRF token and retry once[39m
[31m+         // Only for state-changing methods with CSRF-related error codes[39m
[31m+         if ([39m
[31m+           response.status === 403 &&[39m
[31m+           ['POST', 'PUT', 'PATCH', 'DELETE'].includes(method) &&[39m
[31m+           (errorCode === 'CSRF_INVALID' || errorCode === 'CSRF_MISSING' || errorCode === 'CSRF_VALIDATION_FAILED')[39m
[31m+         ) {[39m
[31m+           logger.warn('[API Client] 403 CSRF error - re-fetching CSRF token');[39m
[31m+           const csrfRetryResponse = await this.handleCsrf403([39m
[31m+             normalizedEndpoint,[39m
[31m+             method,[39m
[31m+             restOptions,[39m
[31m+             requestHeaders,[39m
[31m+             timeoutController.signal,[39m
[31m+           );[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+           if (csrfRetryResponse.ok) {[39m
[31m+             // Capture CSRF token from retry response[39m
[31m+             const retryCsrf = csrfRetryResponse.headers.get('X-CSRF-Token');[39m
[31m+             if (retryCsrf) {[39m
[31m+               setCsrfToken(retryCsrf);[39m
[31m+             }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+             const retryContentType = csrfRetryResponse.headers.get('content-type') ?? '';[39m
[31m+             if (retryContentType && !retryContentType.includes('application/json')) {[39m
[31m+               const rawBody = await csrfRetryResponse.text();[39m
[31m+               return (rawBody || null) as TResponse | null;[39m
[31m+             }[39m
[31m+             const retryPayload = await this.parseJsonSafely<TResponse>(csrfRetryResponse, service, normalizedEndpoint);[39m
[31m+             return this.unwrapApiResponse<TResponse>(retryPayload, retryContentType);[39m
[31m+           }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+           // Second failure — fall through to normal error handling[39m
[31m+           let csrfRetryErrorMessage = errorMessage;[39m
[31m+           try {[39m
[31m+             const retryErrorData = await csrfRetryResponse.text();[39m
[31m+             if (retryErrorData) {[39m
[31m+               const parsed = JSON.parse(retryErrorData);[39m
[31m+               csrfRetryErrorMessage = parsed.error || parsed.message || csrfRetryErrorMessage;[39m
[31m+             }[39m
[31m+           } catch {[39m
[31m+             // Use original error message[39m
[31m+           }[39m
[31m+           const csrfStatusError = new Error(csrfRetryErrorMessage) as Error & { status: number };[39m
[31m+           csrfStatusError.status = csrfRetryResponse.status;[39m
[31m+           const csrfEnhancedError = ApiErrorHandler.enhanceError({[39m
[31m+             endpoint: normalizedEndpoint,[39m
[31m+             method,[39m
[31m+             statusCode: csrfRetryResponse.status,[39m
[31m+             originalError: csrfStatusError,[39m
[31m+           });[39m
[31m+           throw csrfEnhancedError;[39m
[31m+         }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+         // Create error with status for retry logic[39m
[31m+         const statusError = new Error(errorMessage) as Error & { status: number; data?: Record<string, unknown> };[39m
[31m+         statusError.status = response.status;[39m
[31m+         if (errorResponseData) statusError.data = errorResponseData;[39m
[31m+         if (fieldErrors && Object.keys(fieldErrors).length > 0) {[39m
[31m+           ;(statusError as Error & { fieldErrors?: Record<string, string> }).fieldErrors = fieldErrors[39m
[31m+         }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+         // For 5xx errors, throw the raw status error so retry logic can inspect it[39m
[31m+         if (response.status >= 500) {[39m
[31m+           throw statusError;[39m
[31m+         }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+         // For 4xx errors, enhance and throw (no retry)[39m
[31m+         const enhancedError = ApiErrorHandler.enhanceError({[39m
[31m+           endpoint: normalizedEndpoint,[39m
[31m+           method,[39m
[31m+           statusCode: response.status,[39m
[31m+           originalError: statusError,[39m
[31m+         });[39m
[31m+         throw enhancedError;[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       // For non-JSON responses (file downloads, CSV), return raw response[39m
[31m+       const contentType = response.headers.get('content-type') ?? '';[39m
[31m+       if (contentType && !contentType.includes('application/json')) {[39m
[31m+         // Non-JSON response — return raw body without envelope unwrapping[39m
[31m+         const rawBody = await response.text();[39m
[31m+         return (rawBody || null) as TResponse | null;[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       const payload = await this.parseJsonSafely<TResponse>(response, service, normalizedEndpoint);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       // Unwrap { success, data } envelope from API responses[39m
[31m+       // Pass content-type so non-JSON responses skip unwrapping (Req 8.4)[39m
[31m+       return this.unwrapApiResponse<TResponse>(payload, contentType);[39m
[31m+     } catch (error) {[39m
[31m+       // Convert timeout AbortError to a named TimeoutError for retry logic[39m
[31m+       if ([39m
[31m+         error instanceof DOMException &&[39m
[31m+         error.name === 'AbortError' &&[39m
[31m+         timeoutController.signal.aborted[39m
[31m+       ) {[39m
[31m+         // Check if it was our timeout (not an external abort)[39m
[31m+         if (!externalSignal || !(externalSignal as AbortSignal).aborted) {[39m
[31m+           const timeoutError = new Error(TIMEOUT_ERROR_MESSAGE);[39m
[31m+           timeoutError.name = 'TimeoutError';[39m
[31m+           throw timeoutError;[39m
[31m+         }[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       // Check if this is an abort error (request cancelled by user/navigation)[39m
[31m+       const isAbortError =[39m
[31m+         error instanceof Error &&[39m
[31m+         (error.name === 'AbortError' ||[39m
[31m+           error.message?.includes('aborted') ||[39m
[31m+           error.message?.includes('cancelled'));[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       // For abort errors, just rethrow without enhancement[39m
[31m+       if (isAbortError) {[39m
[31m+         throw error;[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       // For retryable errors (network/5xx), rethrow as-is so the retry loop handles them[39m
[31m+       if (isRetryableFailure(error)) {[39m
[31m+         throw error;[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       // Re-throw AuthenticationError as-is (already handled by 401 intercept logic)[39m
[31m+       if (error instanceof AuthenticationError) {[39m
[31m+         throw error;[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       // Enhance error if not already enhanced[39m
[31m+       if (!(error instanceof Error) || !error.message.includes('Please')) {[39m
[31m+         const errorWithStatus = error as { status?: number };[39m
[31m+         const errorStatusCode =[39m
[31m+           typeof errorWithStatus?.status === 'number' ? errorWithStatus.status : undefined;[39m
[31m+         const enhancedError = ApiErrorHandler.enhanceError({[39m
[31m+           endpoint: normalizedEndpoint,[39m
[31m+           method,[39m
[31m+           statusCode: errorStatusCode,[39m
[31m+           originalError: error,[39m
[31m+         });[39m
[31m+         throw enhancedError;[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       throw error;[39m
[31m+     } finally {[39m
[31m+       clearTimeout_();[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+ }[39m
